decision.llm_reasoning: The course includes a specific module on 'Risk Management' and identifying/proposing solutions to control risks.

evidence.text: The course equips students with foundational knowledge and skills in selecting and applying traditional IT project management processes and tools, covering project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and controlling, and closing phases. It also enables students to master popular management tools such as WBS, Gantt Chart, PERT, CPM, MS Project, as well as techniques for managing project scope, cost, schedule, human resources, and risk.

Upon completion of the course, students are able to systematically build, organize, and execute IT project management plans to meet organizational and stakeholder requirements, while effectively applying project management tools and techniques in practical situations.
